main_text.p: manentis in æternum: Iesu Christo, sponso & Seruatore ei benedicete, velut Rosa intermedias spinas efflorescit, & fœcunda est, etiam tristissimo hoc tempore, & discentiu pia agmina ac d ocetium classes quadoq; fundit, & amanter copletitur. Sedet enim omnipotens & æternus ille Dei Filius, Dominus noster Iesus Christus, ad dextera æterni Patris: & adest Ecclesiæ suæ, eãq; donis suis implet. Etsi aut è militatis Ecclesiæ cotubernio, nunc huc, nunc illuc Pastore aut Doctore, in cælestè subducti patria (sicut hoc anno 1583. die 6. Martij, V. Cl. D. Zachariæ Vrsini Vratislauiensis, S. Theologiæ Doctore orthodoxu, ad Christu in cœlum migrasse cöstat) no tamē Princeps ille pastorū & doctorū, Ecclesiā orphana relinquit sed eã, se ardenter inuocate, exaudit, & operarios fidos in copiosam suã messe emittit, ac sanctificat eosdē ad suu opus, ad coagmentatione Sanctorum, & adificatione corporis Christi. In horum aut numero, Virum Reuerendum, fide in Christum zelo pro gloria & veritate Euangelij præstante, & in praxi Ministerij Ecclesiastici diu multumq; benè versatum, D. page.notes: The last line is cut off at the bottom edge of the scan; "Aca-" is the hyphenated start of a word that continues on the next page. Doubtful readings: "ac d ocetium classes quadoq;" (the word before "classes" is unclear), "copletitur", "discentiu", "tristissimo" (long s and the ligature are hard to make out), and "subducti" (the end of the word is faint).
